summary: Callaway Golf Company filed an 8-K reporting the election of Thomas G. Dundon and Mark D. Mandel to its Board of Directors at the 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, along with the entry into standard indemnification agreements for non-employee directors. The filing also reports shareholder approval of proposals voted on at the annual meeting. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The indemnification agreements and routine director elections and shareholder votes are ordinary corporate governance matters, not a special situation.
